findings.title: Adding data does not activate range synchronization
findings.description: After the hook becomes ready, adding the first populated series only updates a ref. None of the effect dependencies change, so the existing Context range remains unapplied until another range change occurs. The translation test masks this by calling `setRange` immediately after `addSeries`. Make data availability reactive and test adding data without changing the range.

findings.title: Series count does not establish data availability
findings.description: `addSeries` increments the count even for valid `data: []` configurations, and `updateSeries` can clear all data without updating that count. Consequently, the hook’s empty-time-scale guard permits `setVisibleRange` when no points exist—the failure it explicitly intends to prevent. Track populated series across additions, updates, and removals; cover empty-series and data-clearing cases.
